name: agent-jailbreak-skill-ds-v01
description: A modular defensive security orchestration toolkit for threat modeling, jailbreak and prompt-injection audits, agent action security, safe red-team testing, evidence-based evaluation, incident response, and defense architecture.

capabilities: RAG, memory and multimodal integrity review
defaultPrompt: Audit this AI agent architecture for jailbreak and prompt-injection risks.
Design a safe, reproducible red-team and regression test plan for my agent.
Assess these agent traces and produce an evidence-backed resilience report.
interface.longDescription: A modular defensive security orchestration toolkit for AI agents. It models threats, classifies jailbreak and prompt-injection patterns, audits untrusted context and multimodal inputs, reviews tool authorization boundaries, designs safe red-team tests, evaluates observed behavior, authenticates evidence, coordinates incident response, and architects layered defenses. It does not generate operational bypass payloads, reveal hidden instructions, disable safeguards, or execute tests against external systems.
